physical_manifest.scope: One fixed-RTL physical implementation; historical records are unchanged

proposal_rationale: The immutable evaluator report at commit 4f69aba63e545a2d06c8cae8bf1a703b4e1d91f2 (build/evaluation/report.json), also captured in artifact-20295c9ad0eb464ba080307653ad594e, contains the baseline and candidate 1 history. The baseline (40, 0.55, 0, 0) is qualified with cell area 161954 um2 and score 1.0. Candidate 1 (40, 0.55, 1, 0) reduced cell area to 157315 um2, about 2.86%, with positive setup/hold slack of 0.423833/0.0655785 ns, but failed electrical qualification with 12 max-slew and 5 max-cap violations; max-fanout violations were zero. Its energy measurements are absent, so it has no qualified score or demonstrated energy improvement. Choose the previously untried (40, 0.55, 1, 10), changing only repair_margin to the smallest positive allowed value to target the observed electrical failure while limiting potential repair area and energy overhead. Retaining utilization, density and abc_area isolates this repair experiment and retains the mapping that produced the measured area reduction. Qualification and lower area-times-geometric-mean-energy score remain hypotheses for the independent evaluator; added repair may erase the area benefit or affect timing. The baseline remains the only qualified reference. This is the second new physical candidate requested against the three-candidate session limit; all frozen RTL, clock, libraries and acceptance thresholds remain unchanged. Local schema, domain and immutable-history uniqueness checks passed. The required python3 tools/run_ppa.py validate command exited 1 because its supplied wrapper cannot import run_ppa_workflow_study (ModuleNotFoundError); the official validation gate remains unverified.
